        if(document.cookie.indexOf('epp_geo=')!==-1) return;

        var p=location.pathname;

        var map={SA:'/sa/',OM:'/om/',AE:'/ae/'};
        var cur='';
        var prefixes=['/sa/','/om/','/ae/'];
        for(var i=0;i<prefixes.length;i++){
            if(p===prefixes[i].slice(0,-1)||p.indexOf(prefixes[i])===0) cur=prefixes[i];
        }
        var ajaxUrl='/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php?action=epp_geo_country';
        var x=new XMLHttpRequest();
        x.open('GET',ajaxUrl);
        x.withCredentials=true;
        x.timeout=5000;
        x.onload=function(){
            try{
                var d=JSON.parse(x.responseText);
                if(!d.success||!d.data||!d.data.country){done();return;}
                var cc=d.data.country;
                var target=map[cc]||'';
                done(cc);
                if(target===cur) return;
                var newPath=p;
                if(cur&&newPath.indexOf(cur)===0){
                    newPath='/'+newPath.substr(cur.length);
                }
                if(target){
                    newPath=target+newPath.substr(1);
                }
                newPath=newPath.replace(/\/\/+/g,'/');
                location.replace(location.origin+newPath+location.search+location.hash);
            }catch(e){done();}
        };
        x.onerror=x.ontimeout=function(){done();};
        x.send();
        function done(cc){
            document.cookie='epp_geo='+(cc||'X')+';path=/;max-age=86400;SameSite=Lax';
        }
    })();
    </script>

/* =====================================================
   Emirates Pride - GWP Offer Section
===================================================== */

.ep-gwp{
    display:flex;
    align-items:stretch;
    width:100%;
    max-width:1320px;
    margin:70px auto;
    background:#fff;
    /*border:1px solid #D8C8A5;*/
    border-radius:3px;
    box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
    overflow:hidden;
}

.ep-left,
.ep-right{
    flex:1;
    width:50%;
}

/* LEFT IMAGE */

.ep-left{
    display:flex;
    background:#fff;
    padding:20px;
}

.ep-left img{
    width:100%;
    height:600px;
    object-fit:cover;
    display:block;
    border-radius:2px;
}

/* RIGHT CONTENT */

.ep-right{
    position:relative;
    padding:55px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    justify-content:center;
    background:#fff;
}

/* TITLE */

.ep-right h2{
	font-size:24px;
    margin:0;
    padding:0;
    font-weight:700;
    line-height:1.15;
    color:#111111;
    text-transform:capitalize;
    letter-spacing:.5px;
}

.rtl .ep-right h2{
    font-size:30px;
    text-transform:none;
}

/* GOLD LINE */

.ep-right h2:after{
    content:"";
    display:block;
    width:140px;
    height:2px;
    background:#8C774F;
    margin:22px 0 30px;
}

/* DESCRIPTION */

.ep-content{
    max-width:470px;
}

.ep-content p{
    margin:0 0 20px;
    font-size:14px;
    line-height:1.8;
    color:#333333;
}

/* HIGHLIGHT */

.ep-highlight{
    margin:0 0 22px;
    font-size:18px;
    font-weight:400;
    line-height:1.7;
    color:#111111;
    text-transform:capitalize;
}

.rtl .ep-highlight{
    font-size:22px;
    line-height:1.7;
    text-transform:none;
}

/* NOTE */

.ep-content small{
    display:block;
    margin-top:12px;
    font-size:13px;
    line-height:1.8;
    color:#777777;
}

/* BUTTON */

.ep-btn-wrap{
    margin-top:0px;
}

.ep-btn{
    display:inline-block;
    background:#8C774F;
    color:#fff !important;
    text-decoration:none;
    padding:4px 15px;
    font-size:10px;
    font-weight:normal;
    letter-spacing:1px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    border-radius:2px;
    transition:all .3s ease;
}

.ep-btn:hover{
    background:#75633F;
    color:#fff !important;
}

/* RTL */

.rtl .ep-right{
    direction:rtl;
    text-align:right;
}

.rtl .ep-btn{
    align-self:flex-start;
	font-size:11px;
}

/* RESPONSIVE */
@media (min-width:992px){
.ep-note{
	    bottom: 40px;
    position: absolute;
}

	}

        flex-direction:column;
    }

    .ep-left,

        width:100%;

    }

  function getSiteKey() {

  function getSiteBasePath() {

  function normalizeText(text) {

  function getGiftTypeFromText(text) {
    var normalized = normalizeText(text);

    if (normalized.indexOf('white hand') !== -1 || normalized.indexOf('body lotion') !== -1 || normalized.indexOf('وايت هاند') !== -1 || normalized.indexOf('لوشن') !== -1) {

        if (giftText && text.indexOf(normalizeText(giftText)) !== -1) {
          found = true;
        }
      });
    });

    return found;
  }

  function ensurePopup(mode, imageSrc, messageText) {
    var popup = document.getElementById('epp-gift-popup');
    var label = mode === 'added' ? getGiftLabel() : getPromoTag();

    if (!popup) {
      popup = document.createElement('div');
      popup.id = 'epp-gift-popup';

        '<button type="button" class="epp-gift-popup__close" aria-label="Close">×</button>' +

      });

  function hidePopup() {

    var bodyClass = document.body.className || '';

    if (/\bwoocommerce-cart\b/.test(bodyClass) || /\bwoocommerce-checkout\b/.test(bodyClass)) {
      return false;

    if (/\bsingle-product\b/.test(bodyClass)) {

  function parseAmount(text) {
    var cleaned = (text || '').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ');
    var matches = cleaned.replace(/,/g, '').match(/-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g);
    if (!matches || !matches.length) {
      return 0;
    }
    return parseFloat(matches[matches.length - 1]) || 0;
  }

  function getCartSubtotalAmount() {
    var selectors = [
      '.cart_totals .cart-subtotal .woocommerce-Price-amount',
      '.cart_totals tr.cart-subtotal td',
      'tr.cart-subtotal td',
      '.order-total .woocommerce-Price-amount'
    ];

    for (var i = 0; i < selectors.length; i += 1) {
      var node = document.querySelector(selectors[i]);
      if (node) {
        var amount = parseAmount(node.textContent || node.innerText || '');
        if (amount > 0) {
          return amount;
        }
      }
    }

    return 0;
  }

  function qualifiesForGift() {

    if (priceCell) {
      priceCell.innerHTML = '';
    }

    if (quantityCell) {
      quantityCell.innerHTML = '<span class="ep-gift-row__qty">1</span>';
    }

    subtotalCell.innerHTML = '<span class="ep-complimentary-gift-value">' + label + '</span>';
  }

  function buildInjectedGiftRow(templateRow, type, productData) {
    var row = templateRow.cloneNode(true);
    var thumbCell = row.querySelector('.product-thumbnail');
    var removeCell = row.querySelector('.product-remove');

    row.className = row.className + ' ep-gift-row ep-gift-row--injected';

    if (removeCell) {
      removeCell.innerHTML = ' ';
    }

    if (thumbCell) {
      var image = productData && productData.images && productData.images[0] ? productData.images[0] : null;
      if (image && (image.thumbnail || image.src)) {
        var imageSrc = image.thumbnail || image.src;

        var imageHtml = '<img src="' + imageSrc + '" alt="' + imageAlt + '" class="attachment-woocommerce_thumbnail size-woocommerce_thumbnail" decoding="async">';
        thumbCell.innerHTML = productData && productData.permalink ? '<a href="' + productData.permalink + '">' + imageHtml + '</a>' : imageHtml;
      } else {
        thumbCell.innerHTML = '';
      }
    }

    formatGiftRow(row, type, productData);
    return row;
  }

  function syncCartGiftRows(products) {
    var tbody = getCartTableBody();
    if (!tbody) {
      return;
    }

    var rows = getCartRows(tbody);
    var realGiftRows = [];

    rows.forEach(function (row) {
      var type = getGiftTypeFromText(row.textContent || '');
      if (type) {
        realGiftRows.push({ row: row, type: type });
      }
    });

    realGiftRows.forEach(function (entry) {
      formatGiftRow(entry.row, entry.type, products[entry.type]);
    });

    removeInjectedGiftRows(tbody);

    if (!qualifiesForGift()) {
      return;
    }

    if (realGiftRows.length >= 2) {
      return;
    }

    var templateRow = rows[0];
    if (!templateRow) {
      return;
    }

    var typesToInject = ['lotion', 'wash'];
    typesToInject.forEach(function (type) {
      var alreadyPresent = realGiftRows.some(function (entry) {
        return entry.type === type;
      });

      if (!alreadyPresent) {
        tbody.appendChild(buildInjectedGiftRow(templateRow, type, products[type]));
      }
    });
  }

  function evaluatePromo(products) {
    if (!isAllowedPromoPage()) {
      return;
    }

    if (popupDismissed || popupVisible || findGiftInCart(products)) {
      return;
    }

    ensurePopup('promo', getGiftImageSrc(products), getPromoMessage());
  }

  function runGiftLogic() {
    fetchGiftProducts().then(function (products) {
     //syncCartGiftRows(products || {});
      evaluatePromo(products || {});
    }).catch(function () {
      syncCartGiftRows({});
      evaluatePromo({});
    });

  function bindWooEvents() {
    if (!window.jQuery) {
      return;
    }

    jQuery(document.body).on('updated_wc_div wc_fragments_refreshed wc_fragments_loaded added_to_cart removed_from_cart updated_checkout', function () {
      setTimeout(runGiftLogic, 200);
    });
  }

  function startObserver() {
    if (observerStarted || !document.body) {
      return;
    }

    observerStarted = true;
    var observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
      runGiftLogic();
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true
    });
  }

  function init() {
    bindWooEvents();
    setTimeout(runGiftLogic, PROMO_DELAY_MS);
    startObserver();
    setInterval(runGiftLogic, 3000);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
